You chose option 4, so here are the repositories FrameCore Works recommends. I'm assuming **Claude Code** as the agent, since this session runs there. Registry checked 2026-10-21. I read the registry file directly and installed nothing. The commands below are printed for reference only and none have been run.

For every `native` entry the steps are plan (dry run), install, verify, remove. Restart Claude Code after installing. Each one is pinned to the reviewed version, and a newer release is not installed.

## Research

**1. REA: Reverse Engineer Anything** — [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea), npm `rea-agents@6.5.0`, MIT, engine
- **Does:** reverse-engineers software you may analyse (native binaries, Electron/JS apps, .NET, Android, sites via DevTools, network captures). Every finding comes with its evidence and unknowns.
- **Studio already bundles:** a web motion probe, which answers first for web animation. REA is optional depth for desktop apps, bundles and source maps.
- **Claude Code (native):** needs Node 22.19+, 24.11+ or 26+, and a Chrome-family browser for sites.
```sh
npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 setup --client claude_code --dry-run --json   # plan
npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 setup --client claude_code --yes              # install
npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 doctor --client claude_code --json            # verify
npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 uninstall                                     # remove
```
- **Other agents:** Codex native. Claude desktop app only. ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work: not supported.

**2. Agent Reach** — [Panniantong/agent-reach](https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach), commit `94f06c1`, MIT, engine
- **Does:** installs and routes to tools that read the public web (Jina Reader pages, YouTube transcripts, RSS, public GitHub, Exa search). Use only channels that need no login.
- **Studio already bundles:** nothing. It adds reach for Research Evidence when the host's own web tools can't read a page.
- **Claude Code (native):** needs Python 3.10+ with pipx, and Node for the Exa channel.
```sh
pipx run --spec https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach/archive/94f06c1969dfc1834001269d79d3ad0972d9dee6.zip agent-reach install --env=auto --dry-run
pipx install https://github.com/Panniantong/agent-reach/archive/94f06c1969dfc1834001269d79d3ad0972d9dee6.zip && agent-reach install --env=auto --system
agent-reach doctor
agent-reach uninstall && pipx uninstall agent-reach
```
- **Other agents:** Codex native. Claude apps, ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work: not supported.

## Motion graphics

**3. Animate (cth9191)** — [cth9191/animate](https://github.com/cth9191/animate), commit `7e5eb56`, MIT, engine
- **Does:** short procedural canvas animations with a synthesized score, in seven illustrated styles, rendered to MP4.
- **Studio already bundles:** an adapted Animate engine. Install this for the upstream skill or its newest styles.
- **Claude Code (native):** needs Node 18+, Playwright with Chromium, and FFmpeg.
```sh
git clone https://github.com/cth9191/animate ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate && git -C ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate checkout 7e5eb56feb2dd573f890e1b7b34748af43d58263 && cat ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
test "$(git -C ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate rev-parse HEAD)" = 7e5eb56feb2dd573f890e1b7b34748af43d58263 && claude plugin marketplace add ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate && claude plugin install animate@animate
claude plugin list
claude plugin uninstall animate@animate && claude plugin marketplace remove animate && rm -rf ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/animate
```
- **Other agents:** Codex native. Claude apps, ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work: not supported.

**4. Motion Designer (kaventro)** — [kaventro/motion-designer](https://github.com/kaventro/motion-designer), commit `7d0b8bb`, MIT, engine
- **Does:** app launch films from code. It shows the real UI in a phone or laptop frame, cuts to music on the beat, checks frame by frame and renders.
- **Studio already bundles:** a partial adaptation. This is the original launch-film pipeline.
- **Claude Code (native):** needs Node 22+, Chrome, FFmpeg, Python 3 and uv.
```sh
git clone https://github.com/kaventro/motion-designer ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer && git -C ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer checkout 7d0b8bb78ddd2c91c57db9d1e83fcf711304bdb8 && cat ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json
test "$(git -C ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer rev-parse HEAD)" = 7d0b8bb78ddd2c91c57db9d1e83fcf711304bdb8 && claude plugin marketplace add ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer && claude plugin install motion-designer@motion-designer
claude plugin list
claude plugin uninstall motion-designer@motion-designer && claude plugin marketplace remove motion-designer && rm -rf ~/.framecore-studio/extensions/motion-designer
```
- **Other agents:** Codex: not supported, because the skill's front matter is invalid YAML at this commit. Claude apps, ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work: not supported.
